# curl (libcurl, vendored)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project | libcurl, the curl project's URL transfer library |
| Upstream | <https://curl.se/>, <https://github.com/curl/curl> |
| Version | `8.23.0` (release tarball) |
| Archive | <https://curl.se/download/curl-8.23.0.tar.gz>, SHA-256 `e3de77cfa6367083c776a26647fc9f633b538c06c3baa73d931a252ac8f72b49` (4,465,093 bytes; matches the SHA-256 curl.se publishes at <https://curl.se/info>) |
| License | curl license (MIT-style; SPDX `curl`), `COPYING` copied verbatim |
| Files | `COPYING`; `lib/Makefile.inc` (the build reads its source list) and the library sources of its `CSOURCES`, with every header they include for the profile below; the public headers of `include/curl/`. No curl tool, tests, docs or other build files. All are byte-identical to the archive above (`.gitattributes` keeps them out of end-of-line conversion) |
| Modifications | none |

Use: Darwin's `/usr/lib/libcurl.4.dylib` for guest programs (cmake, cargo). `scripts/build_alchemy_libcurl.ps1` compiles these sources against `runtime/include` (no SDK) with `runtime/libcurl/curl_config.h` and links an ARM64 Mach-O guest runtime library. The profile (HTTP and FILE, threaded resolver, no TLS backend) is described in that configuration header.

To update: download the new release from the upstream above, check its published hash, copy the same set of files, and update this file, the hashes and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
